title: Background summary fails before producing a report
context: The background worker cannot produce its report: the report service fails when querying SQLite. Running the report on an already available database succeeds.
expected: A fresh background summary returns label Open tasks and count 0 without manual setup.
observed: The background worker cannot produce its report: the report service fails when querying SQLite. Running the report on an already available database succeeds.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh background summary returns label Open tasks and count 0 without manual setup.
